subject: Klarna taps Robinhood VP 👑, Last mile problem for stablecoins 🪙, PayPal partners with Workday 👱
notes: Klarna CFO appointment kept as an 'other/leadership' entry because it is the issue's lead story. Blue J's Series D and Anthropic's last private round are background entries only.

stories.headline: Anthropic expected to IPO at a valuation of at least $1.33 trillion
stories.quote: Anthropic's expected IPO at a valuation of at least $1.33 trillion could generate major gains for a broad investor base spanning venture firms, large technology companies, private equity, and sovereign wealth funds.

facts.text: Expected IPO valuation of at least $1.33 trillion
facts.quote: Anthropic's expected IPO at a valuation of at least $1.33 trillion

facts.text: Most recent private raise was at a $965 billion valuation
facts.quote: The company most recently raised private capital at a $965 billion valuation, meaning the IPO could mark another substantial step-up for existing shareholders.

stories.headline: Blue J raises $176M Series E led by JMI Equity at a valuation above $700M
stories.quote: Blue J raised a $176 million Series E led by JMI Equity at a valuation above $700 million to expand Workflows, an agentic product that checks returns before filing, drafts replies to IRS notices, and reviews partnership agreements.
stories.description: AI agents and research engine for tax work

more than 6,500 organizations use its research engine

stories.headline: Blue J's earlier Series D, cited as the baseline for its ARR growth
stories.quote: The company says ARR grew 165% in the 15 months after its Series D, and that more than 6,500 organizations use its research engine.
stories.description: AI agents and research engine for tax work

stories.headline: Klarna appoints Robinhood VP Chris Koegel as CFO, starting in January
stories.quote: Klarna has appointed Chris Koegel as its new chief financial officer starting in January. Koegel served as vice president, head of corporate finance, and investor relations at cryptocurrency platform Robinhood.

facts.text: Koegel joined Robinhood in 2022; its valuation grew from under $10 billion to over $100 billion in that time
facts.quote: He joined the company in 2022 and saw its valuation grow from under $10 billion to over $100 billion.

stories.headline: Italian court places Revolut's Italian operations under one year of judicial administration over anti-money laundering failures
stories.quote: An Italian court placed Revolut Bank UAB's Italian operations under one year of judicial administration after finding serious anti-money laundering deficiencies that allegedly allowed 24 suspected or convicted criminals to move €41.9 million through the bank

facts.text: Court found 24 suspected or convicted criminals allegedly moved €41.9 million with no suspicious transaction reports filed
facts.quote: allegedly allowed 24 suspected or convicted criminals to move €41.9 million through the bank without Revolut filing any suspicious transaction reports.

stories.headline: PayPal partners with Workday so employees can set up PayPal Direct Deposit and get pay up to two days early
stories.quote: PayPal announced a partnership with Workday that lets employees of Workday customers set up PayPal Direct Deposit through Workday's Enhanced Direct Deposit (EDD) program, giving eligible employees in the US a way to receive their pay up to two days early.

stories.headline: Plaid launches Agent Detection to tell human activity from AI agents in financial sessions
stories.quote: Plaid launched Agent Detection to help banks and fintechs distinguish human activity from AI agents across login, onboarding, account linking, and money movement, including identifying which AI provider is behind a session.

facts.text: Plaid's own claim: 2.3x more agent sessions detected than competitors in live testing
facts.quote: Plaid says the system detected 2.3x more agent sessions than competitors in live testing

stories.headline: Mastercard opens an innovation centre of excellence in Singapore, to house 250 specialists eventually
stories.quote: Mastercard has opened an innovation centre of excellence in Singapore that will eventually house 250 specialists working in areas such as AI, digital commerce, and cybersecurity.
